## Change and reason

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Work item

Link the added or updated `docs/work-items/YYYY-MM-DD-topic.md` record.

## Validation

Commands and actual results; include manual evidence for UI or deployment changes.

## Risks and rollback

Compatibility, migrations, operational impact, and recovery (or explain why none apply).

## Review

- [ ] Work item explains decisions, acceptance criteria, and next steps.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; unrun checks and limitations are explicit.
- [ ] Deployment or migration evidence is recorded if applicable.
